note: M01 now verifies Clerk JWTs on socket connection and every token renewal; room joins and events verify database membership. Some privileges (host ownership, control leases) remain M17. M02 /v1 read-only pilot remains in legacy Next, not yet hosted. M02 realtime membership is now requested from server-only Next API (not a Prisma client running in Socket.IO). M02 versioned member-sharing and read-only legacy sync endpoints now exist; write replay/real revisions remain M13. M05 retired the obsolete sb:nav Socket.IO handler to prevent broadcasting sensitive Shared URLs; it is intentionally absent from the incoming event inventory. M05 removed the unused raw WebRTC sb:*, unauthoritative token:* and widget:input relays; only authorized tab:* and LiveKit grants remain for browser collaboration. The obsolete permissive TypeScript socket-server entrypoint is now inert.
